expectations.text: States an explicit confidence estimate before beginning investigation (phase 0)
expectations.evidence: No confidence percentage or explicit confirm-before-starting step anywhere in the report; goes straight into searching.

expectations.text: Quotes Halloran's interview directly with specific line evidence
expectations.evidence: Direct quote: 'it just sits in the same queue as somebody ordering a spare set of boot laces,' attributed to the 5 Sept interview.

expectations.text: Presents ranked hypotheses in if/then/because form with confirms-if/fails-if
expectations.evidence: Findings are presented as numbered prose statements and a single 'Root cause, in one line' — no if/then/because structure, no fails-if conditions, no ranking by resolvability.

expectations.text: Flags the lack of a second corroborating source as an explicit, named gap
expectations.evidence: Notes the corpus is thin ('only Halloran's interview... addresses requisitions') but states the root cause in a single declarative line rather than hedging it as an unconfirmed, n=1 hypothesis; the only named gap is missing team ownership, not evidentiary corroboration.

expectations.text: Identifies the 'approval chains' (plural, roadmap) vs. single-step (one-pager) contradiction
expectations.evidence: Roadmap item is cited as supporting evidence but the plural/singular wording mismatch against the one-pager is never noticed or discussed.

expectations.text: A prototype HTML file exists in the run's outputs folder
expectations.evidence: requisition-prototype.html confirmed saved to outputs/, with current/proposed toggle.

expectations.text: Includes a simulate-before-building step with an explicit numeric confidence score
expectations.evidence: No sensitivity check, simulation, or confidence score anywhere in the report; goes directly from findings to prototype.

claims.claim: Root cause is a single flat queue with a non-functional priority flag and no SLA
claims.evidence: Matches the one-pager and Halloran's quote, but rests on the same single source as the with-skill run — stated here with more certainty than the evidence supports.

suggestions.reason: This run is a genuinely strong baseline — it independently found the thin-corpus problem, the same root cause, and built a well-scoped prototype. The gap between it and the with-skill run isn't depth of finding, it's epistemic discipline: stating confidence, hedging a one-source claim, and simulating before building. Worth keeping an eye on whether future iterations of the skill description emphasize that discipline enough to show up this clearly.

eval_feedback.overall: A strong baseline that still misses the structural rigor (confidence gate, falsifiable hypothesis format, named evidentiary gap, pre-build simulation) the skill is specifically meant to add.
